parameters.query:
-- Up to 20 items per run, newest first, so a backlog clears over a few runs
-- instead of one long run that overlaps the next.
--
-- A source that does not allow summaries is copyright, not quality: those
-- items go to a person instead and are never sent to the model, even when an
-- editor asked.
WITH held AS (
    UPDATE items i
       SET status = 'manual',
           status_reason = 'the source does not allow AI summaries, handle by hand'
      FROM sources s
     WHERE s.id = i.source_id
       AND i.status = 'queued'
       AND NOT s.summarization_allowed
    RETURNING i.id
)
SELECT i.id, i.title, i.raw_text,
       (SELECT value FROM app_settings WHERE key = 'llm_provider') AS llm_provider,
       (SELECT value FROM app_settings WHERE key = 'llm_base_url') AS llm_base_url
  FROM items i
  LEFT JOIN sources s ON s.id = i.source_id
 WHERE i.status = 'queued'
   AND coalesce(s.summarization_allowed, TRUE)
 ORDER BY coalesce(i.published_at, i.fetched_at) DESC
 LIMIT 20;

-- One statement, so an item is never marked summarised without a summary.
-- A failed call is written down with its reason instead of leaving the item
-- looking as if it is still waiting. Link and publisher are added by the
-- database, see db/init/12-summaries.sql.
WITH s AS (
    INSERT INTO summaries (item_id, language, text, provider, model)
    SELECT $1::bigint, 'fi', btrim($2), $3, $4
     WHERE nullif(btrim($2), '') IS NOT NULL
    ON CONFLICT (item_id, language) DO UPDATE
       SET text = EXCLUDED.text, provider = EXCLUDED.provider,
           model = EXCLUDED.model, generated_at = now()
    RETURNING item_id
)
-- If the AI could not be reached at all, the article goes back to the queue
-- for the next run. Only an answer that was no use marks it failed.
UPDATE items
   SET status        = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s) THEN 'summarised'
                            WHEN $5 ~* '(ECONNREFUSED|ECONNRESET|ETIMEDOUT|ENOTFOUND|EAI_AGAIN|timed? ?out|socket hang up|status code (5[0-9]{2}|429))'
                              THEN 'queued'
                            ELSE 'summary_failed' END,
       status_reason = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s) THEN status_reason
                            WHEN $5 ~* '(ECONNREFUSED|ECONNRESET|ETIMEDOUT|ENOTFOUND|EAI_AGAIN|timed? ?out|socket hang up|status code (5[0-9]{2}|429))'
                              THEN 'waiting for the AI to answer again'
                            ELSE left(coalesce(nullif($5, ''), 'the model returned no text'), 300) END
 WHERE id = $1::bigint
RETURNING id, status, status_reason, title,
          -- set when an editor sent this link to the bot
          (SELECT u.telegram_user_id FROM users u WHERE u.id = items.captured_by) AS telegram_user_id;
